verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Linear has its own MCP server (linear-probe-1) and an official MCP docs page, plus Okta-based access management for MCP (linear-docs-67), indicating Linear can act as an MCP host/server. However, there's no evidence Linear itself lets users plug in third-party MCP servers so Linear's AI agent can consume their tools — the agent capabilities described (coding, browser testing, Slack) appear to be built-in integrations rather than user-configurable MCP client functionality.
